summary: Americas Gold & Silver filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 9, 2026, announcing its inclusion in the Toronto Stock Exchange's 2026 TSX30 ranking of top-performing issuers, at 24th place, citing a 477% dividend-adjusted share price gain over the three years ended June 30, 2026 and $2.2 billion of market capitalization growth. The release is promotional and operational, highlighting silver and antimony assets and a 51/49 antimony joint venture, with no transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock. No special-situation event is present; watch only for follow-on operational or financing disclosures.
